question: Whom does the guru worship before addressing the lord of the site?
premises: The lord of the site is addressed.
inference: The guru first worships the self-born, then addresses the site lord.
uncertainties: The exact relation of Brahmaṇaḥ is not explicit.
plain_english: Having worshipped the self-born, address the lord of the site, also Brahmaṇaḥ.
